response: Once upon a time, in a far-off land, there was a brave knight named Sir Galahad. He was known throughout the kingdom for his valor and chivalry. One day, while on a quest to rescue a princess, he encountered a dragon. Instead of fighting the dragon, he befriended it and they became inseparable companions. They traveled the land together, with Sir Galahad teaching the dragon to breathe fire and the dragon teaching Sir Galahad to fly. They were the most unlikely of friends, but together they faced many adventures and became legends in their own right.
